title: Lead Technician cannot be changed on a Paid work order's page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • 2 technicians eligible at this location: active, Role Technician, at least one Department, Location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, Time Clock on. Names are examples ("Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Paid Lead Lock" (used by this case only) with one contact and one asset.
  • One work order [WO-1] for that customer with one line, Lead Technician = [Tech-A], status Paid (invoiced and fully paid).
  • What must hold: the lead was set before invoicing; [Tech-B] is a different eligible technician. Names and numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-A] (the expected results call this technician "Esther Howard").
  2. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-B] (the expected results call this technician "Ralph Edwards"). Use a second, different technician.
  3. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Paid Lead Lock" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Paid Lead Lock" > Asset = its asset > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-366").
  5. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close. The status reads Approved.
  6. On [WO-1], on the status card at the left, click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-A]. (Lead Technician is a dropdown only once the work order is Approved; while it is an Estimate it reads "Unassigned" and cannot be changed.) The choice saves at once.
  7. Bring it to Complete: on the Lines tab click Complete on the line > Tech Story: type any text > if a "Missing Details (1)" step shows, click it and type a Mileage > Complete Line (or Complete All Lines). The message "Work order sent to review." appears and the status reads Review. Click Mark Reviewed; if a Mark as reviewed window asks for VIN, type any 17 characters (e.g. 1FVACWDT1BDAZ0001) > Confirm Review. The status reads Complete.
  8. Click the Finance tab > Create Invoice. The status reads Invoiced and a New Customer Payment window opens: Payment Method = Cash > Make Payment. The status reads Paid.
  9. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > search [WO-1] > open it. The status reads Paid and the status card shows Lead technician [Tech-A]. If the status is not Paid, finish the step that is missing.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, search [WO-1] and open the Paid work order [WO-1].
  2. Look at the Lead Technician field on the work order's status card (left of the page).
  3. Click the Lead Technician field and try to pick [Tech-B].
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the Lead Technician field shows "Esther Howard" and is shown disabled (greyed out).
  • Step 3: it does not open a list, or it lets nothing be picked. The lead cannot be changed to Ralph Edwards.
  • Step 4: after the reload Lead Technician still reads "Esther Howard".
  • The Invoiced status is checked on the work order page by the feature case for Invoiced and Paid locks.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): On a Paid work order the status card shows "Lead technician" with the name as plain read-only text (no dropdown arrow); it is not shown as a greyed-out field, and clicking it opens nothing. After the reload it still shows the same name. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 1; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §7; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (§4 Key Decisions). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply High 1: “Status card, Lead Technician select: the lock rule is new (disabled on Invoiced and Paid).”
  • QA handoff §7: “On the detail page status card, the lead select is disabled on Invoiced and Paid.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (lead lock): “Lead technician cannot be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid. This is a product rule, not only a screen rule, so it must hold on every path that changes the lead technician — board drag, Reassign dialog, and the work order detail page.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
